record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Consistency strength of mutual stationarity on the sequence of cardinals ω_n at cofinality ω_1, with optional CH.
record.original_question: What is the exact consistency strength of the principle MS(⟨ω_n | n<ω⟩, ω_1), optionally together with CH, where MS(⟨κ_α⟩_{α<δ}, λ) means that for every sequence ⟨S_α | α<δ⟩ of stationary sets with S_α ⊆ κ_α ∩ cof_λ, the sequence is mutually stationary, i.e. the set {X ∈ [sup_{α<δ} κ_α]^λ | sup(X∩κ_α) ∈ S_α for all relevant α} is stationary?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup and definitions. Work in ZFC. For a cardinal λ and a cardinal κ > λ, let cof(λ) denote the class of ordinals of cofinality λ, and for a cardinal κ let κ ∩ cof(λ) = {α < κ : cf(α) = λ}. Given a strictly increasing sequence of regular cardinals ⟨κ_α : α < δ⟩ with sup_{α<δ} κ_α = κ, and a regular cardinal λ < κ_0, a sequence ⟨S_α : α < δ⟩ with each S_α a stationary subset of κ_α ∩ cof(λ) is said to be mutually stationary if the set
  S := { X ∈ [κ]^λ : sup(X ∩ κ_α) ∈ S_α for every α < δ such that sup(X ∩ κ_α) has cofinality λ relevant in S_α }
is stationary in [κ]^λ (i.e., meets every club subset of [κ]^λ).

Let MS(⟨κ_α : α < δ⟩, λ) denote the assertion: for every sequence ⟨S_α : α < δ⟩ with each S_α a stationary subset of κ_α ∩ cof(λ), the sequence is mutually stationary.

Question. Determine the exact consistency strength, measured on the standard large cardinal hierarchy, of the principle
  MS(⟨ω_n : n < ω⟩, ω_1).
Determine also the exact consistency strength of MS(⟨ω_n : n < ω⟩, ω_1) together with the Continuum Hypothesis (CH).
artifact.category_tag: Mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: Available sources indicate that mutual stationarity at ⟨ω_n⟩ with uncountable cofinality ω_1 is a strong principle (much stronger than the cofinality-ω case, which is a ZFC theorem of Foreman–Magidor). Recent work (e.g., Adolf–Ben-Neria on lower consistency bounds with divergent cofinalities, Ben-Neria's papers on singular stationarity) establishes lower and upper bounds but does not pin down the exact consistency strength of MS(⟨ω_n⟩, ω_1) (with or without CH). The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities and limited covering
status_evidence.snippet: Improves previous work on the consistency strength of mutually stationary sequences of sets concentrating on points with divergent cofinality.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides lower consistency bounds but not exact strength.

status_evidence.title: Consistency strength results about mutual stationarity (Koepke talk)
status_evidence.snippet: Hierarchy: measurable ⇒ Prikry ⇒ MS(κ_0,κ_1,...) ⇒ singular Jónsson ⇒ measurable in inner model.
status_evidence.claim: Known bounds bracket but do not determine the exact strength.

status_evidence.title: Some Open Problems in Mutual Stationarity Involving Inner Model Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Commentary listing the consistency strength of MS(⟨ω_n⟩, ω_1)(+CH) as an open question.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as open.
